erase.title: Erase {{name}}'s data?
erase.body: This permanently deletes the documents listed below and the data derived from them: the stored files, extracted facts and page text, search-index entries, knowledge-graph data and analysis records. The applicant's name is also removed from the webhook delivery log.
erase.scope: Documents still being analysed, failed, or not matched to an applicant are not touched. Use this for an applicant's erasure request.
erase.notErased: Not erased here: chat conversations and artifacts that mention the applicant (delete them yourself, or they are deleted automatically after the retention period) and verdicts already sent to your CRM.
erase.typeLabel: To confirm, type the applicant's name:
erase.exactHint: Type the name exactly as shown, including capital letters.
erase.mismatchHint: The name does not match yet.

errors.mismatch: The name typed does not match the applicant's name (HTTP 400).
errors.notFound: No such applicant in this project – it may have been erased already (HTTP 404).

errors.uncertain: The erase may be incomplete ({{reason}}). The verdict was cleared and the documents list reloaded: run the check again to see what is left, and erase again if needed.

webhook.title: Smart Dial / CRM webhook
webhook.intro: While on, every document that finishes analysis sends its applicant's file-check verdict to your CRM as a signed HTTPS POST (event file_check.completed).
webhook.urlHint: HTTPS only, port 443 (default) or 8443, a public host, no user:password@. Leave empty to remove the webhook.
webhook.urlNotHttps: The URL must start with https:// – the server refuses it otherwise.
webhook.enabledHint: Off: nothing is sent. On needs a URL and a signing secret.
webhook.needsSecret: Generate a signing secret below before turning deliveries on.

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.hint: Smart Dial uses the secret to check that a delivery came from here. It is shown only once, when generated.
secret.confirmReplace: Replace the current secret? Deliveries are signed with the new one right away, so Smart Dial rejects them until you update the secret there too.
secret.once: Copy this secret now and store it in Smart Dial. It cannot be shown again.
secret.copyManual: Copying is blocked here: the secret is selected, press Ctrl+C.

test.hint: Sends a signed event "test" with no applicant data (also while deliveries are off).
test.needsSetup: Save a URL and generate a secret to send a test event.

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.retention: The last 20 deliveries of the past 7 days; older ones are deleted.

verify.title: How Smart Dial verifies it
verify.intro: Each delivery is an HTTPS POST with a JSON body and these headers:
verify.steps: Smart Dial recomputes HMAC-SHA256 with the shared secret (UTF-8) over the timestamp t, a dot and the raw request body, compares the hex digest with v1 in constant time, and rejects a timestamp more than 5 minutes from its clock. Retries keep the same X-SmartDial-Delivery id, so a repeated delivery can be ignored.
